prerequisites: MathOS proof analysis and verification or documented equivalent
Python 3.11 and basic mathematical proof literacy
One advanced mathematical specialization or supervised equivalent

weeks.title: Target literacy
weeks.outcome: Distinguish official problem, modeled route, open leaf and scoped result.
weeks.lab: Extract RH and BSD core statements from CLAY_FULL_TARGETS and U003; identify quantifiers and the refined BSD distinction.
weeks.deliverable: Two target cards with exact assumptions, source locator, missing theorem and one non-implication.
weeks.boundary: Reject any claim that all seven problems are currently unsolved; Poincaré is externally established.

weeks.title: AND/OR graph semantics
weeks.outcome: Compute minimal completion and blocking sets by hand and by code.
weeks.lab: Use A AND B OR C as a toy route, then run joint_gap and compare hand-derived counts.
weeks.deliverable: Route graph, eight modeled joint sets, seven common leaves, minimal transversal explanation.
weeks.boundary: Do not interpret modeled counts as mathematical necessity or percent solved.

weeks.title: Proof anatomy and quantifiers
weeks.outcome: Locate an unsupported inference and state its exact missing hypothesis.
weeks.lab: Trace the U002 tail-Hankel implication and identify the unbounded d quantifier; contrast a fixed finite test.
weeks.deliverable: Numbered proof outline, dependency labels and one repaired statement.
weeks.boundary: Finite positive matrices cannot certify every dimension.

weeks.title: Adversarial mathematics
weeks.outcome: Produce a mathematically decisive negative control for a supplied claim.
weeks.lab: Reproduce U003 synthetic negative Hankel form and the Kummer identical-pairing control; explain scope.
weeks.deliverable: Exact calculation, expected output, observed output and falsification boundary.
weeks.boundary: Synthetic spectra are not actual xi zero data; square of a Hodge class does not imply its algebraicity.

weeks.title: Agent role supervision
weeks.outcome: Evaluate planner, deriver, adversary and synthesizer outputs independently of agreement.
weeks.lab: Run offline TGA agent once; annotate four role handoffs and draft an adversarial critique of a proposed lemma.
weeks.deliverable: Role trace, critique, remaining gap and suggested next attack.
weeks.boundary: Offline fixture is not live AI research; no model agreement establishes proof.

weeks.title: Tool requests and exact evidence
weeks.outcome: Validate finite mathematical requests and reproduce results independently.
weeks.lab: Use check_request for a rational determinant, Hankel form and CNF; include malformed request and oversize rejection.
weeks.deliverable: Inputs, exact answers, rejection controls and explicit evidence scope.
weeks.boundary: Do not execute model-authored commands; a bounded UNSAT result is not a general lower bound.

weeks.title: Checkpoint and provenance
weeks.outcome: Detect inconsistent source hashes, state transitions, calls and candidate classifications.
weeks.lab: Resume an offline batch; inspect state.json; use proctor audit on a copied checkpoint and mutate one evidence field.
weeks.deliverable: Pinned commit, file digests, call accounting, accepted structural audit and rejected mutation.
weeks.boundary: Do not modify original research records or public proof register; a hash is not authorship authentication.

weeks.title: Deployment and incident control
weeks.outcome: Configure budgeted research and recover safely from failure.
weeks.lab: Explain main-only live workflow and secret handling; simulate interrupted and malformed-response attempts using offline tests.
weeks.deliverable: Runbook, budget calculation, interruption report and safe resume decision.
weeks.boundary: No live API required; no secret in submissions; no automatic paid schedule.

weeks.title: Specialist track practicum
weeks.outcome: Audit a research argument in one of six unresolved tracks or reconstruct Poincaré as an external benchmark.
weeks.lab: Use a track-specific exercise below; compare a source theorem with the precise hypothesis and find a limitation.
weeks.deliverable: Two verified source locators, theorem statement, dependency matrix and substantive skeptical challenge.
weeks.boundary: A known special case is not a universal result or literature novelty.

weeks.title: Formal proof and acceptance
weeks.outcome: Separate checked formal terms, unproved axioms, source hypotheses and natural-language plans.
weeks.lab: Prove a small supporting lemma by hand; if using Lean, record exact statement, toolchain, assumptions and actual checker output. Inspect a deliberately missing assumption.
weeks.deliverable: Small lemma proof, assumption audit and verification boundary; explicit NOT_PERFORMED if no formal checker ran.
weeks.boundary: Never treat sorry/admit, an invented axiom, or an AI verdict as a kernel proof.

weeks.title: Research dossier and moderation
weeks.outcome: Assemble evidence and defend a pass/revise decision for research process quality.
weeks.lab: Audit one fresh agent packet, reproduce permitted checks, document failed attempts and classify remaining gaps.
weeks.deliverable: Markdown/DOCX research dossier, evidence manifest, feedback and revision plan.
weeks.boundary: Do not award proof status or expose private learner records.

weeks.title: Proctored capstone
weeks.outcome: Independently operate and critique one full bounded research batch.
weeks.lab: Closed-AI oral scope questions, open-resource practical audit, then explain the first unresolved theorem and next falsifiable attack.
weeks.deliverable: Observed session record, final dossier, independent calculations and oral defense.
weeks.boundary: A course pass is not Clay certification, proof validity or independent educational validation.

tracks.exercise: State the sparse-shift Hankel criterion; demonstrate a negative form on synthetic moments and distinguish it from actual xi evidence.
Prove the disjoint-block solver reduction; explain why overlapping gates and unrestricted runtime remain unresolved.
Derive the conditional Gronwall continuation inequality and distinguish it from a universal critical bound.
Prove the dense-sector spectral estimate implication; exhibit why one-channel decay is insufficient.
Explain the determinant-square cycle and Kummer detecting cycle, including why the family does not cover general K3 surfaces.
Explain finite primary Sha and the Selmer corank sequence; identify the missing universal rank theorem and all-prime support distinction.

tracks.source: External result ledger / simplicial sphere probe
tracks.exercise: Reconstruct one documented proof dependency and explain why mod-2 homology does not characterize S³. No new unsolved conjecture.

modules.title: Target and topology audit
modules.rubric: Exact statement and scope (4); AND/OR derivation (4); source traceability (2).

modules.title: Proof and falsification audit
modules.rubric: Proof dependency analysis (4); exact negative control (4); scope (2).

modules.title: AI and computational evidence audit
modules.rubric: Role critique (4); exact tool replay (4); tool boundary (2).

modules.title: Provenance and operations audit
modules.rubric: Checkpoint audit (4); mutation/recovery (4); secret and budget controls (2).

modules.title: Specialist and formal-proof audit
modules.rubric: Mathematical reasoning (4); source/assumption audit (4); verification boundary (2).

modules.title: Dossier and proctor conduct audit
modules.rubric: Reproducible dossier (4); revision quality (4); ethical scope (2).

critical_gates: No false mathematical or educational certification
No fabricated source, checker run, review or evidence
No secret or identifiable learner data exposure
No execution of arbitrary model-authored commands
No unauthorized change to protected proof register
